title: 第3章 讨回公道第4章 斩断过往
slug: 恶毒师妹失忆后师兄们悔疯了
content_zh:
念及此，江凌寒眼底只剩下冷漠。
下一秒，他周身狂暴的灵力骤然迸发，掌心凝聚起浑厚的灵力，狠狠朝着那条银鞭拍去。
只听“咔嚓”几声脆响，上品灵器竟被他硬生生震断，成了好几段。
碎裂的鞭身落在地上，灵光瞬间黯淡下去，成了一堆废铁。
而灵器的反抗也让他闷哼一声，吐出一口鲜血，红得刺眼。
叶怀渊阻止不及，语气里满是痛惜。
“师弟，你这又是何苦呢？哪怕师妹不肯再用，这鞭子既是你的一番心意，留着也是个念想啊！”
“念想？”
江凌寒冷笑一声，抬手擦去嘴角的血迹，竟衬得他的眉眼有一丝迤逦。
“那就不必了。”
说完，他快步出门，直往苏虞的小院御剑飞去。
叶怀渊无奈地摇了摇头：“师弟还是这么急性子。”
随后又生出些对苏虞的责怪。
明知道师弟会因此生气，却还是这样做，半点都不顾念同门情谊。
看来落雪说的是对的，小师妹还是被宠得太过了，竟一点都不为别人着想。
……
沈落雪也知道最近的流言，却没放在心上。
直到听闻江凌寒怒气冲冲跑去找苏虞，她正在拨弄琴弦的纤白手指微微一顿。
琴声立即发出一道短促的杂音。
沈落雪却没太在意，反而微微勾起了唇角。

失忆了好啊。
不仅做出这样的蠢事，也忘记在地宫里，不是她推了她——
而是她自己靠过去的。
可谁又会相信呢？
***
苏虞的小院里。
江凌寒收剑落地，周身火气未消，灼热的灵力波动让空气微微扭曲。
他几步并作一步上前，猛地一脚踹在门上。
“苏虞！你给我出来！”
声音里带着压抑不住的怒意，还有一丝连他自己都未曾察觉到的委屈。
凭什么东西她说还就还？！哪怕要划清界限，也得他来做才行！
“你以为躲着不见人，装作失忆，就能把一切都抹掉吗？！”
“我告诉你，不可能！你欠大师姐的，你一辈子都还不清！”
提到沈落雪，江凌寒眼中怒焰更盛。
叶怀渊或许只以为他性子暴烈，才看不惯苏虞的所作所为。
可只有江凌寒自己才知道其中的缘由。
那还是在他刚筑基不久下山历练时，他不慎落入邪修陷阱，身受重伤，意识模糊。
是恰巧路过的沈落雪发现后，不嫌弃他血肉模糊的惨状，用珍贵的丹药救了他一命。
从那以后，她在他心中便有了特殊的位置，他敬她，护她，容不得任何人说她半分不好。
于是处处跟她作对的苏虞，自然就成了他的仇人。

而她还东西的举动，更是成了对他的挑衅！
“你说话啊！”
江凌寒又是一脚踹上去，门都快被他踹烂了。
刚把丹药装好的苏虞烦不胜烦地把门打开，对上江凌寒微红的双眼。
只用一句话就让他冷静下来。
content_en:
Thinking of this, Jiang Linghan's eyes were filled with only indifference.
The next second, the violent spiritual power around him suddenly burst out, and the strong spiritual power condensed in his palm, and he slapped the silver whip fiercely.
There were just a few crisp sounds of "click", and the high-grade spiritual weapon was broken by him forcefully, and it was broken into several pieces.
The broken whip body fell to the ground, and the spiritual light dimmed instantly, turning into a pile of scrap metal.
The resistance of the spiritual weapon also made him groan and spit out a mouthful of blood, which was so red it was dazzling.
Ye Huaiyuan was unable to stop him, and his tone was full of regret.
"Junior brother, why are you doing this? Even if junior sister refuses to use it anymore, since this whip is your heart, keeping it is just a thought!"
"Nianxiang?"
Jiang Ling laughed coldly and raised his hand to wipe away the blood from the corner of his mouth, which made his eyebrows look slightly wrinkled.
"That's not necessary."
After saying that, he quickly went out and flew straight to Su Yu's small courtyard to control his sword.
Ye Huaiyuan shook his head helplessly: "Junior brother is still so impatient."
Then there were some accusations against Su Yu.
He knew that his junior brother would be angry because of this, but he still did it without caring about the friendship between his fellow disciples.
It seems that what Luoxue said is right, the junior sister is still too spoiled and doesn't think about others at all.
…
Shen Luoxue also knew about the recent rumors, but didn't take them to heart.
Until she heard that Jiang Linghan was angrily running to find Su Yu, her delicate white fingers that were playing with the strings paused slightly.
The sound of the piano immediately made a short murmur.
Shen Luoxue didn't pay much attention, but raised the corners of her lips slightly.
Amnesia is good.
Not only did she do such a stupid thing, but she also forgot that she was not the one who pushed her in the underground palace——
But she leaned over by herself.
But who would believe it?
***
In Su Yu's small courtyard.
Jiang Linghan sheathed his sword and landed on the ground. The fire around him was still lingering, and the scorching spiritual power fluctuations made the air slightly distorted.
He stepped forward a few steps at a time and kicked the door violently.
"Su Yu! Come out!"
There was uncontrollable anger in his voice, and a hint of grievance that even he himself was unaware of.
Why did she return the things just because she said so? ! Even if we have to draw a clear line, he has to do it!
"Do you think you can erase everything by hiding from people and pretending to have amnesia?!"
"I tell you, it's impossible! What you owe Senior Sister, you will never be able to repay in your lifetime!"
When Shen Luoxue was mentioned, Jiang Linghan's eyes became even more angry.
Ye Huaiyuan probably only thought that he had a violent temper, so he couldn't stand what Su Yu did.
But only Jiang Linghan himself knew the reason.
That was when he went down the mountain for training not long after building the foundation. He accidentally fell into the evil cultivator's trap, was seriously injured and became confused.
Shen Luoxue, who happened to be passing by, found out that he was in a bloody state and saved his life with precious elixirs.
From then on, she had a special place in his heart. He respected her, protected her, and would not tolerate anyone saying anything bad about her.
So Su Yu, who was always against her, naturally became his enemy.
And her action of returning the things became a provocation to him!
"Speak!"
Jiang Linghan kicked him up again, and the door was almost broken by him.
Su Yu, who had just packed the elixir, opened the door angrily and met Jiang Linghan's reddish eyes.
Calm him down with just one sentence.
